name: Their Halls of Stone
game_text: <phase>Skirmish</phase>: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at an underground site).
flavor_text: “‘These are not holes,’ said Gimli. ‘This is the great realm and city of the Dwarrowdelf. And of old it was not darksome, but full of light and splendour, as is still remembered in our songs.’”
